newsitem.title: USA: Ill. riverboat revs up 12.25 pct in July over June.
newsitem.headline: Ill. riverboat revs up 12.25 pct in July over June.

text.p: Illinois riverboat casino revenues rose 12.25 percent in July to $91.18 million compared to the previous month, and showed a slight increase from a year ago, the state gaming board reported.
Despite the monthly increase in adjusted gross receipts, the year-to-date revenues of $619.8 million for the state's riverboat casinos reflect an 11 percent decline from 1996 year-to-date figures.
Casino admissions rose 13 percent in July over the previous month, to 2.22 million. Admissions ran 4.6 percent over July 1996.
